$comment: Config for the workflow plugin (~/.config/opencode/plugins/workflow.ts). A project can override any key via <worktree>/.opencode/workflow.json. Restart opencode after editing because model profiles are baked into the tool description at startup. 'models' is the allowlist of exact model and reasoning-variant pairs for workflow agents; each optional 'note' guides when to select that profile and name distinct verifier perspectives. Empty list means agents use the session default model.

models.note: Web researcher, evidence gatherer, browser user
